memory: ClawManager is a Kubernetes-first control plane for managing OpenClaw and Linux desktop runtimes at team and cluster scale.

The stable repo layout is Go backend in backend/, React 19 + TypeScript frontend in frontend/, primary deployment manifests in deployments/k3s/, and longterm/workspace as the legacy project-memory layer.
Primary deployment target is K3S, with deployments/k3s/clawmanager.yaml as the main deployment artifact; k8s manifests are secondary alignment targets.
Do not hardcode secrets or provider keys in the repo; use Kubernetes Secrets or environment variables.
ClawManager development follows Spec-Kit: spec -> plan -> tasks before implementation, and dynamic status should stay outside constitution files.
Prefer Chinese for project communication and operator-facing memory notes unless a conflicting requirement is explicit.
Use commander-style packetized execution: keep tasks bounded, define ownership and stop conditions, and require evidence before declaring completion.
Prefer minimum viable correction and light-weight delivery; avoid broad refactors unless a smaller boundary cannot fix the defect.
For the local K3S runtime path, the validated control-plane registration route is HTTP clawmanager-gateway:9001, backed by 9001 -> 9001 gateway service exposure.
Do not reopen the disproven https://...:8443 URL-builder route as the primary runtime registration fix unless new evidence disproves the validated 9001 -> 9001 chain.

As of the 2026-04-15 P1 internal RC effort, live ARM runtime bring-up is proven but still depends on the dev runtime image ghcr.io/yuan-lab-llm/clawmanager-openclaw-image/openclaw:dev-arm64-pkt09-20260414170434, so it is not yet a fresh-deploy productized default.

As of the 2026-04-15 P1 internal RC effort, the live chain is working but U3 cannot be treated as passed because skill-scanner remains disabled by default on local K3S and the final task inventory is not yet frozen.
For P1 replay and fresh deploy work, do not rely on residual cluster state, residual MySQL data, residual PVCs, undocumented manual DB edits, or other hidden live-state reuse.
P1 model bootstrap requires at least one active non-secure model and one active secure model, both supplied by operator-provided values rather than repo defaults.
If direct QA fails only because active model records or provider credentials are missing, classify it as a model-bootstrap blocker rather than a runtime bring-up failure.

As of the stopped F-002 verification packet, ordinary-user POST /api/v1/instances can fail with 500 'failed to build instance gateway config: no active models are configured' when no active model records exist.

Future architecture direction: ClawManager should evolve toward a central control plane that connects to external standalone hosts or Claw boxes and dispatches work from one center. This is a durable direction, not current packet scope.
Do not mirror longterm/, AgentTeam/, or docs/superpowers/ into Mem0 as full text; treat them as source material and import only distilled durable facts.
